_about: Company templates (server/company.js). Each sets seats with charters, 1-3 goals, starter tasks and rhythms. Plain starting points: edit everything after you pick one. Budgets start at 0 so nothing assumes money you haven't set.

templates.name: Blank company
templates.blurb: Four lean seats: CEO, Build, Grow, Run. Fill in the rest yourself.

charter.goal: Pick one goal for this month and say it out loud
charter.done: Everyone knows this month's goal and who owns what.

charter.goal: Ship the first version people can try
charter.done: A link someone outside the team can open and use.

charter.goal: Find the first 10 people who want this
charter.done: 10 real people said yes (signed up, replied or paid).

charter.goal: Keep the week calm: tasks current, nothing waiting
charter.done: No task older than a week without an owner.

goals.title: Get the first version into people's hands

tasks.title: Write the mission in one sentence
List the 3 things the first version must do

templates.name: Software product
templates.blurb: A small online tool people pay for. Build, grow, support, and know your numbers.
templates.mission: Make a small online tool that saves people time, and keep the people who use it happy.

charter.goal: Decide who the product is for and the one problem it solves
charter.done: A one-line pitch everyone on the team repeats the same way.

charter.goal: Ship the smallest version that solves the problem
charter.done: Signed-up users can do the main job without help.

charter.goal: Get the first 25 sign-ups from people who aren't friends
charter.done: 25 sign-ups, and we know where each one came from.

charter.goal: Answer every user question within a day
charter.done: No question older than 24 hours; repeat questions have a help page.

charter.goal: Know what we spend and earn each week
mayDo: compare plans of the tools we use
charter.done: A weekly line: spent, earned, left. (A starting point, not financial advice.)

goals.title: Launch to the first real users
A product that does one job well

results.text: Main flow works end to end

tasks.title: Write the one-line pitch: who it's for and what it fixes
Build the sign-up and the main screen
Draft a landing page with one button
List 5 places our users already hang out
Write the first help page: getting started

templates.name: Agency or studio
templates.blurb: Do work for clients: find them, deliver well, get paid on time.
templates.mission: Do excellent work for a few good clients, deliver on time, and get paid fairly.

charter.goal: Pick the kind of client we serve best
charter.done: A clear 'we help X do Y' line on the website.

charter.goal: Book 3 discovery calls
charter.done: 3 calls on the calendar with people who could hire us.

charter.goal: A portfolio page with our 3 best pieces
charter.done: Portfolio live, every piece cleared with its client.

charter.goal: Deliver every client project on the agreed date
charter.done: Every project has a date, an owner and a preview link.

charter.goal: Every invoice sent and tracked
mayDo: remind the CEO of late payments
charter.done: No unpaid invoice older than 30 days without a follow-up. (A starting point, not financial advice.)

tasks.title: Write 'we help X do Y' in one sentence
List 20 businesses we'd love to work with
Pick 3 pieces for the portfolio and ask the clients if we may show them
Make a simple proposal template

templates.name: Creator business
templates.blurb: Videos, posts or a newsletter: make things regularly and grow an audience.
templates.mission: Make things people look forward to, regularly, and turn the audience into a small, steady income.

charter.goal: Pick the topic and the posting rhythm we can keep
charter.done: A posting calendar we've kept for 4 weeks straight.

charter.goal: One finished piece every week
needsApproval: use music or clips we didn't make
charter.done: 4 pieces done, each with its sources and licenses noted.

charter.goal: Grow the email list: the audience we own
charter.done: Every piece also goes out as a newsletter issue.

charter.goal: A simple page for sponsors and partners
charter.done: A media kit with real numbers only, and 10 brands that fit.

tasks.title: Pick the topic and write it in one line
Plan the next 4 pieces
Set up the newsletter sign-up

templates.name: Game studio
templates.blurb: Make a game, build a community around it, and release it.
templates.mission: Make a game people play with their friends, and release it to a community that helped shape it.

charter.goal: Lock the core loop and the release date
charter.done: A one-page game pitch and a date everyone agrees on.

charter.goal: A playable build with the core loop
charter.done: A friend can play 5 minutes without a crash or help.

charter.goal: One finished level's look and sound
charter.done: Level 1 looks and sounds finished; every asset's license is credited.

charter.goal: Gather the first playtesters
charter.done: 20 people played a build and told us what they think.

tasks.title: Write the one-page game pitch
Build the core loop in one test level
Pick the palette and draw the player
Post the first devlog with a gif

templates.name: Local business
templates.blurb: A shop, café, salon or service: be easy to find, book and recommend.
templates.mission: Be the place people nearby recommend: easy to find, easy to book, a pleasure to visit.

charter.goal: Decide this month's one improvement
charter.done: One clear improvement that customers notice.

charter.goal: Up-to-date listings and a simple website
mayDo: write the menu or price list
charter.done: Hours, address and prices are right everywhere people look.

charter.goal: Every message and booking answered the same day
charter.done: Nothing unanswered at the end of the day.

charter.goal: Stock, staff and the week planned
charter.done: The week's plan is written down by Monday.

results.text: Bookings or orders through the site

tasks.title: Check hours, address and phone on every listing
Make a one-page website with a booking or contact button
Write answers to the 5 questions customers ask most

templates.name: Nonprofit or cause
templates.blurb: Do good on purpose: programs, volunteers and donors, with honest reports.
templates.mission: Help the people we serve in a way we can measure, and tell supporters honestly how it's going.

charter.goal: Agree the one outcome we measure this quarter
charter.done: One outcome, how we count it, and who counts it.

charter.goal: Run this month's program and count who it helped
charter.done: The program ran and the numbers are written down.

charter.goal: Thank every supporter and grow the list
charter.done: Every gift thanked within a week; one honest update a month.

charter.goal: Know every coin in and out
charter.done: A monthly in/out sheet that matches the bank. (A starting point, not financial or legal advice: check local rules.)

tasks.title: Write the outcome we measure and how we count it
Plan the next program session
Draft a thank-you note template

templates.name: Club or community
templates.blurb: A group that meets: events, members and a friendly place to talk.
templates.mission: Bring people together around something we love, regularly, and make newcomers feel at home.

charter.goal: Set the meeting rhythm and this season's plan
charter.done: Everyone knows when we meet and what's coming.

charter.goal: The next two events booked
charter.done: Two dates, places and hosts set.

charter.goal: Welcome every newcomer personally
charter.done: Every new member got a welcome within two days.

tasks.title: Pick the regular meeting day and time
Book the next event
Write a short welcome note for newcomers
